gitCommit.subject: Update Playwright configuration and enhance pulse sentiment tests
gitCommit.body:
Update Playwright configuration and enhance pulse sentiment tests

- Adjusted retry logic in Playwright config for local testing.
- Improved test steps for clarity and added more sentiment analysis cases in pulse.spec.js.
- Enhanced error handling and verification steps for file uploads and sentiment generation.
